root.label: NAZA added to Venice competition lineup

events.label: NAZA added to Venice competition lineup

slots.name: competition status
slots.sentence: The conflict in Gaza will also take center stage in the documentary “NAZA,” a late addition to the competition, from two of the filmmakers behind the Oscar-winning “No Other Land.”

events.label: NAZA premieres at Venice and wins Special Jury Prize

slots.name: standing ovation duration
slots.sentence: When it premiered at the Venice International Film Festival in mid-September, "NAZA" received a 25-minute-long standing ovation and the Special Jury Prize.

slots.name: interviewed personnel
slots.sentence: It is based on interviews conducted with 24 anonymous military and intelligence personnel, who describe internal procedures and decision-making processes involved in selecting targets in the Gaza Strip.

slots.name: documentary runtime
slots.sentence: The 80-minute documentary examines the Israel Defense Forces' operations during the war in Gaza.

slots.name: people featured
slots.sentence: NAZA features 24 anonymous Israeli intelligence officers and soldiers describing the surveillance and targeting systems they used in Israel's war in Gaza – including AI — and the civilian deaths they say those systems allowed.

slots.name: release status
slots.sentence: After its world premiere at the Venice Film Festival, "NAZA" is now showing in theaters worldwide.
